title: Hero and troop design overhaul
problem: Owner: "okay now lets do a thorough enhancement of heroes and creep design, take Dota 2 characters as the target of what we want to be". Today heroes are cute, big-headed standees (head about a third of the height) with simple costumes.
scope: A heroic body template: about five heads tall, broad shoulders, longer legs, with costume parts (pauldrons, chest armour, belts, skirts, bracers, boots, capes) and smaller, sharper faces
Valve's value pattern on every figure: darker towards the feet, lighter at the head and shoulders
All 20 heroes redesigned around one big signature shape each (oversized weapons, capes, horns, hats, wings), richer materials and glow accents for magic users
Troops redesigned: armoured Kampung militia with team tabards and plumes, beasts and insects with team harness or markings, glowing eyes and sharper anatomy, a golem with glowing cracks
Figures a little larger on screen (heroes 34 to 42 px, troops 21 to 24 px) and portraits framed for the new heads
Sprite-sheet and silhouette checks; docs (art-style guide, design notes)
exclusions: Changes to the rules or balance
Copying any Dota 2 hero, name, costume or shape
New animation frames beyond the existing poses

acceptance.text: Heroic template: about five heads tall, costume parts, value pattern on every figure (sprite sheets reviewed)
acceptance.evidence: Sprite sheets reviewed (idle, walk, three attack beats, hurt, spawn; both teams; play size and 3x): about five heads tall, costume parts on every humanoid hero and militia troop, the value pattern on every hero and troop.

acceptance.text: All 20 heroes redesigned, each with a signature silhouette; the silhouette sheet shows 20 distinct shapes
acceptance.evidence: Silhouette sheet of all 20 heroes in black: each shows its own shape (giant hat, tower shield, umbrella, horns and club, folded wings, trader's pack, scaffold, wave, hood and blowpipe, kite, ears, cobra hood, headdress and puppet). Least distinct: Pendekar, Senja, Embun, Badak and Belang, which each keep one mark (tanjak peak, crescent hat, frost crown, horn, tail and ruff).

acceptance.text: All troop types redesigned for their species, team colour readable on every one
acceptance.evidence: All 22 troop and summon types redrawn (sprite sheets at play size and close-ups, both teams). Team colour on every one: tabards and plumes, shield faces, collars, bands, caparisons, banners and bases.

acceptance.text: Play size: heroes and troops readable and not crowding the lanes in match screenshots; portraits framed
acceptance.evidence: Match screenshots in the usual and zoomed views, plus the draft and versus screens: heroes and troops read and do not crowd the lanes; all 20 portraits framed on the new heads (portrait sheet).

acceptance.text: Originality: no Dota 2 design copied (design notes list each hero's own source)
acceptance.evidence: docs/design/character-art.md lists each hero's own source (Malay craft, dress, animals and tales) and signature shape. No Dota 2 hero was used as a reference shape; the avoided words appear nowhere.

acceptance.text: Speed: 100 cached figures still draw in about 1 ms; frames within budget (measured)
acceptance.evidence: Desktop test browser at iPhone 13 size: 100 cached figures 0.85 ms a frame (was 0.84); busy match frame median 4.2-4.7 ms, 90th percentile 9.7-10.7 ms (two runs; was 4.3-5.8 and 10-14). Drawing each new pose the first time: 1.65 ms against 1.31 ms before (+26%, once per pose).

acceptance.text: Game unchanged: verify, soak and phone check pass; no change in src/game
acceptance.evidence: npm run verify: 96/96 tests and the build pass; the 100-match soak is identical to before (43/45/12, average 312 s, ultimate median 88.05 s, 0 stalls); PHONE CHECK OK (33 PASS, 0 FAIL); git diff of src/game is empty.
Not yet tried on the owner's phone.

risks: Smaller heads hide faces at play size: silhouettes, signature shapes and colours carry identity; faces show in portraits
Bigger figures crowd the lanes: sizes checked in screenshots
Drawing cost: figures stay cached per pose; measured

added: docs/design/character-art.md: each hero's source and signature shape; troop looks; originality check
A heroic figure template in src/ui/figures.ts: five builds and costume parts (pauldrons, chest plate, belt, skirt, bracers, boots, cape), a value pass and glowing eyes
changed: All 20 heroes redrawn with one signature shape each; Belang's tiger form armoured
All 22 troop and summon types redrawn: militia uniforms, team markings, glowing eyes, sharper shapes
Figures a little bigger on screen (heroes 42 px, troops 24 px); portraits framed for the new heads
Art-style guide v4 (character section), owner checklist, README

userNotes: New hero designs: taller, heroic figures with armour, capes and one big signature shape each (a giant hat, a tower shield, an umbrella, horns, wings, a wave), glowing eyes on magic users.
New troop designs: militia in helmets and team tabards, beasts and insects with team markings and sharper looks; figures are a little bigger on screen.

approval.evidence: okay now lets do a thorough enhancement of heroes and creep design, take Dota 2 characters as the target of what we want to be
